<!--
Measured, not read: where the lines of a journal page sit, in the .pdf and
in typst alike. The words are made up so that each is found once.

The headings are set the way the Journal of Educational Psychology sets
them (JEP.pdf at the repository root): a point larger than the 10pt body,
26pt from the baseline above to the heading's, 18pt from the heading's to
the first line under it, and 13pt between the lines of a heading that wraps.
The two formats were set apart by 2 to 8 points on each of these before
they were measured against the journal.

The space between two paragraphs is the space between two lines, 12pt.
typst's was Typst's own 1.2em instead, 7pt more, from Typst 0.12 until
typst-template.typ set par's spacing; nothing in the .typ showed it.
-->

Alphaone alphatwo.

Betaone betatwo.
